answers.reason: The senate handles central university strategy, whereas the faculty administrative officer only participates in the single body dealing with faculty examination matters.
Budget planning is outside the faculty administrative officer's specific domain of organizing examinations and records.
Professorial appointments are separate from the examination matters handled by the faculty administrative officer.
Each member participates in only one place where their specific matters are decided, which for the faculty administrative officer is the examination board rather than the general faculty council.
The study commission deals with degree programme changes rather than the organization of examinations and student records.
The faculty administrative officer organizes examinations and records, making the examination board the single body that matches their specific tasks.
Internal research funding has no bearing on the faculty administrative officer's duties regarding examinations and timetables.
Rewriting module descriptions is a teaching content matter outside the faculty administrative officer's single place of participation.
Laboratory equipment procurement is unrelated to the faculty administrative officer's area of examinations and records.
Planning the orientation week does not fall under the examination and record-keeping matters assigned to the faculty administrative officer.
